children: Popular, Inc. (NASDAQ: BPOP) announced today that it will participate in the upcoming Barclays 24th Annual Global Financial Services Conference to be held in New York City on Tuesday September 15, 2026. Jorge J. Garcia, President and Chief Executive Officer of Popular, Inc., will speak at 9:00 a.m. Eastern Time.
A live audio webcast will be accessible through the Popular, Inc. Investor Relations website at
. A replay of the webcast will also be available.

Popular, Inc. is the leading financial institution in Puerto Rico, by both assets and deposits, and ranks among the top 50 U.S. bank holding companies by assets. Founded in 1893, Banco Popular de Puerto Rico, Popular’s principal subsidiary, provides retail, mortgage and commercial banking services in Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands. Popular also offers in Puerto Rico auto and equipment leasing and financing, broker-dealer and insurance services through specialized subsidiaries. In the mainland United States, Popular provides retail and commercial banking services through its New York-chartered banking subsidiary, Popular Bank, which has branches located in New York, New Jersey and Florida.
